name: Indian-Style Fried Rice with Turkey, Carrots, Green Onions & Cashews

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium carrots
3 red bell peppers
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the carrots.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add half to the bowl and set aside. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add turkey and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
1.02 kg ground turkey
3 tbsp curry powder
1 tbsp cumin, ground
1 tbsp paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the turkey is done, add veggies to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat, add peas, and stir to combine; cover and set aside until the rice is done.
When the rice is done, add to the pot. Return pot to medium-high heat and continue to stir-fry until warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide fried rice between plates or bowls; top with cashews, chili-garlic sauce, and reserved green onions. Enjoy!
